test.title: Getting ready for a job interview

texts.title: Getting ready for a job interview

paragraphs.text: Before an interview, find out as much as you can about the organisation. Reading its website and recent news will help you understand its goals and prepare questions to ask at the end.

Most interviewers ask candidates to give examples of times they solved problems or worked in a team. Preparing three or four short stories from your past experience will help you answer these questions clearly.
Plan your journey carefully and aim to arrive ten minutes early. Arriving too early can be almost as unhelpful as arriving late, as the interviewer may not be ready.
During the interview, listen carefully to each question. It is better to pause and think than to start speaking immediately and give an answer that does not fit.
After the interview, send a short email to thank the interviewer. This is polite and reminds them of your interest in the job. Keep it brief and friendly.

document.title: Getting ready for a job interview

items.quote: will help you understand its goals and prepare questions to ask at the end

explanation.en: Research on the organisation helps you “prepare questions to ask at the end” → A.
explanation.kk: Ұйым туралы мәлімет «prepare questions to ask at the end» көмектеседі → A.
explanation.ru: Информация об организации поможет «prepare questions to ask at the end» → A.

items.quote: Preparing three or four short stories from your past experience will help you answer these questions clearly
items.prompt: Preparing a few short stories from your past

explanation.en: Stories from your past “will help you answer these questions clearly” → E. D is a trap: the text does not say to memorise them.
explanation.kk: Тәжірибеден алынған әңгімелер «will help you answer these questions clearly» → E. D — тұзақ: мәтін сөзбе-сөз жаттауды ұсынбайды.
explanation.ru: Истории из опыта «will help you answer these questions clearly» → E. D — ловушка: заучивать дословно текст не советует.

items.quote: Arriving too early can be almost as unhelpful as arriving late
items.prompt: Arriving at an interview much too early

explanation.en: Coming too early “can be almost as unhelpful as arriving late”, because the interviewer may not be ready → B.
explanation.kk: Тым ерте келу: «Arriving too early can be almost as unhelpful as arriving late», себебі сұхбат алушы дайын болмауы мүмкін → B.
explanation.ru: Слишком ранний приход: «Arriving too early can be almost as unhelpful as arriving late», потому что интервьюер может быть не готов → B.

items.quote: It is better to pause and think than to start speaking immediately
items.prompt: Pausing to think before you answer

explanation.en: During the interview “It is better to pause and think than to start speaking immediately”. “Too quickly” paraphrases “immediately” → F.
explanation.kk: Сұхбат кезіндегі ұсыныс: «It is better to pause and think than to start speaking immediately». «Too quickly» — «immediately» дегеннің басқаша айтылымы → F.
explanation.ru: Совет во время собеседования: «It is better to pause and think than to start speaking immediately». «Too quickly» пересказывает «immediately» → F.

items.quote: This is polite and reminds them of your interest in the job

explanation.en: The email “reminds them of your interest in the job” → C. G contradicts the text: it is sent after, not before.
explanation.kk: Әңгімелесуден кейінгі хат «reminds them of your interest in the job» → C. G мәтінге қайшы: хат әңгімелесуге дейін емес, кейін жіберіледі.
explanation.ru: Письмо после собеседования «reminds them of your interest in the job» → C. G противоречит тексту: письмо отправляют после, а не до.

options.text: can help you think of questions to ask.
can be almost as unhelpful as being late.
reminds the interviewer that you want the job.
should be learned word for word.
makes it easier to answer questions about your experience.
is better than answering too quickly.
should be sent before the interview.
